transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hello. Um... I guess I'm here because... well, work has been difficult. I manage information systems, and... I just keep getting these thoughts. 

Like, if I miss one setting, or... one access rule or a warning sign... that someone could get hurt. Or lose everything. Part of me knows it’s irrational, but... it just hits me like I’m personally responsible. I just... I can’t just move on.
How often do these thoughts come up during your day, and do they interfere with your ability to focus or get things done?

They’re... pretty constant. Most of the day. And, yeah, it interferes. 

Um... work has been bad. We had a major cloud migration, and... I missed the deadline. I just couldn’t finish signing off on the decisions. I couldn't be sure. Now my team mostly just... works around me. They don't rely on me as much. 

And... I don't really do much else anymore. I used to go to basketball, or salsa nights, but... I stopped showing up. Just... losing the routines and the people that used to keep me grounded, I guess.
Do you find that these thoughts come into your mind even when you don't want them to, and do they feel intrusive or unwanted?

Yeah. Um... like I said, I don't... I don't want to be thinking about access rules or missing a setting all the time. Or that someone is going to get hurt because of me. 

I know it doesn't make sense most of the time, but... the thoughts just happen anyway. I don't ask for them. They just... show up, and I can't move past them.

When these thoughts come up, do you feel driven to do something — like checking things over and over, or going through specific mental steps — to reduce the anxiety or prevent something bad from happening?

Yeah... I guess I do. 

Um... I just end up rereading things a lot. Like deployment plans, or... audit logs. Old messages. Even the door locks. I'll check them over and over. Sometimes I... I have to count through the steps in my head, just until it feels... safe, I guess. 

It takes a lot of time. I usually end up staying at the office for hours after everyone else goes home. If I try to stop before it feels complete, I just... I panic. So I stay.
When you're not able to check things like the door locks or deployment plans, how does that make you feel? Do you get very anxious or distressed?

Yeah. I do. 

Um... if I can't check, the anxiety just... it builds up. It feels like something terrible is going to happen, and it's my fault because I didn't make sure. I just... I get really overwhelmed. I can't focus on anything else until I go back and check.
Have these thoughts and behaviors affected your relationships with friends, family, or your performance at work?

Yeah... it has. 

Um... work is getting hard. I actually missed a big deadline recently... for a cloud migration. I just... I couldn't get myself to sign off on the decisions. It took too long. Now my team just... they kind of work around me. They don't really rely on me right now.

And... I guess outside of work, too. I used to play basketball, go to salsa nights... I don't really do that anymore. I just stopped showing up. It's... yeah. I guess I'm losing touch with the people who used to keep me grounded.

Have you ever had persistent thoughts, urges, or images that were not related to your work responsibilities, or felt the need to perform certain behaviors or mental acts in a specific way to reduce anxiety or prevent something bad from happening — even if those things weren't related to your job?

No. Not really. 

Um... it's mostly just the work stuff. And the doors. I don't... I don't really have anything else like that.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about things other than work or safety checks, like everyday events or potential problems, even when there's no clear reason to be concerned?
No... I don't think so. Just normal stuff, I guess. Nothing like the work things.
Do you ever feel restless, fatigued, or have trouble concentrating even when you're not thinking about work or safety checks?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I get tired sometimes, but... just normal tired, I think. If I'm not thinking about work or... the other stuff, I can focus fine. So... no.
Have you noticed yourself feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy, even outside of the anxiety about work or safety checks?
No... I don't think so. I don't feel hopeless or anything like that. I still do the things I normally do when I have the time. So... no.
Have you ever had thoughts, images, or urges that were not about work or safety checks, but still felt intrusive and unwanted, causing you distress?

Um... no. Not really. It's... it's just the work things. That's what brings me in, honestly. I just... I keep getting these thoughts that if I miss one setting... or one access rule, or a warning sign... that someone could get hurt. Or they could lose everything. And... I know it's irrational, but it just hits me like I'm personally responsible for it. I can't just move on. So... no, just that.
Do you ever find it hard to control your worry about things in general, even when they aren't directly related to your work or safety checks?
Uh... no. Not really. If it's not about the systems or... the safety stuff, I don't really worry about it. General things don't bother me like that. So... no.
